topic_title: Human Trafficking Awareness — The Julia Wells Act
prompt: What does the Julia Wells Act mandate for driver education and commercial licensing courses in Texas?

options.text: Mandatory background fingerprint checks for all licensed passenger vehicle drivers
Annual registration fees on commercial freight vehicles to fund border barriers
Human trafficking awareness instruction to help motorists recognize and report signs
Compulsory self-defense martial arts training for teenage driver education students
